WITH totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM manager_award ma
    JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.bats, '') as hand,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM totals) as share
FROM manager_award ma
JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
